svg.title: Greenhouse grower — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as greenhouse grower, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: Two young plants grow from a raised nutrient trough beneath two separate dripper outlets. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: short hair, an oval face.
